meta.title: Cobb County Kids' Summer, School-Break & After-School Camps
meta.disclaimer: Facts come from each provider's own public page on the last-checked date. Prices, dates and availability change, and some entries show the prior season's published rate. Always confirm with the provider. Listing here is not an endorsement, and we have not inspected, licensed, or safety-vetted any program.
meta.geography_focus: Cobb County, GA: Marietta, East Cobb, Smyrna, Kennesaw and nearby

camps.name: Cobb PARKS Recreation Center Day Camps
camps.area: Marietta, Powder Springs, Austell (Fair Oaks, Fullers, Milford, Ron Anderson, Boots Ward, South Cobb rec centers)
camps.price_note: 2026 weekly fee not shown on the county camp page; resident vs. non-resident pricing applies.
camps.dates: Summer weeks plus fall, winter and spring school breaks; weekly themes
camps.registration: 2026 summer registration opened March 4 (county notice: 'camps fill quickly')

camps.name: Cobb PARKS Creative Art Camps
camps.area: Mountain View, Mable House, Sewell Mill (East Cobb), Art Station – Big Shanty
camps.price_note: All art supplies and kiln firing included per county page.
camps.dates: School breaks and summer, half-day and full-day options

camps.name: Cobb PARKS Performing Arts Camps (Jennie T. Anderson Theatre)
Cobb PARKS Tennis Camps
camps.area: Terrell Mill (Marietta), Kennworth, Sweetwater, Lost Mountain

camps.name: Cobb PARKS Nature Camps (Green Meadows)
camps.price_note: May include mountain biking and history.

camps.name: McCleskey-East Cobb Family YMCA Day Camp
camps.area: East Cobb (1055 E. Piedmont Rd, Marietta)
camps.ages: Varies by camp (2025 sheet: traditional 5–12, STEAM 6–12, preschool 3–4)
camps.price_note: YMCA's 2025 rate sheet: traditional $225/$280, sports $250/$315, STEAM $275/$350 (two price tiers). 2026 rates not posted on the overview page. Accepts CAPS; financial assistance (2026 deadline was April 15).
camps.dates: Summer, 9am–4pm; early care 7–9am, after care to 6pm
camps.registration: Non-refundable deposit at registration; program membership needed for non-members; 2027 on-sale date 'coming soon'

camps.name: Northeast Cobb Family YMCA Day Camp
camps.area: East Cobb (3010 Johnson Ferry Rd, Marietta)
camps.category: Day camp, sports, STEM, cooking, art
camps.registration: 2027 on-sale date 'coming soon' per YMCA day camp page

camps.name: Camp Smyrna Summer Camp
camps.area: Smyrna Community Center, 1250 Powder Springs St
camps.price_note: Early care free; after care $40. Break-camp prices 'TBA'.
camps.dates: Summer 9am–4pm; Fall Break Sept 21–25 2026; Winter Break Feb 15–19 2027; Spring Break Apr 5–9 2027
camps.registration: Fall break registration opened Aug 3; summer via Smyrna's Rec system

camps.name: Kennesaw Camp Venture Summer Day Camp
camps.price_note: $50 non-refundable deposit per additional week; waitlist when weeks fill. Price not listed on the city page.
camps.registration: First-come; closes the Wednesday before each week

camps.name: Marietta PAL Summer Camp
camps.area: Hugh L. Grogan Jr. Community Center, 510 Lawrence St, Marietta
camps.price_note: $25 non-refundable registration fee; breakfast, lunch and snacks included; early drop-off +$20/wk.
camps.registration: 2026 final application deadline May 5; full price due May 15

camps.name: Salvation Army of Cobb Summer Day Camp
camps.price_note: $35 registration fee. Includes field trips and swimming per provider page.
camps.registration: Call the Community Center Director (number on source page)

camps.name: Salvation Army of Cobb After School Program
camps.price_note: 'No cost for the program to the family.' Homework help, STEM lab, arts.
camps.dates: School year, 3–6:30pm, follows Cobb/Marietta school calendar

camps.name: Cobb County School District After School Program (ASP)
camps.price_note: $10 per day attended, invoiced weekly; $20 annual registration fee; 4.75% fee on online card/ACH payments.

camps.name: Girls Inc. of Greater Atlanta Break Camp
Bricks 4 Kidz Marietta–Smyrna LEGO Robotics STEAM Camps
camps.area: Smyrna (Bethany UMC), Marietta (St Joseph, St Andrew UMC); Build & Bounce at trampoline parks
camps.price_note: $50 non-refundable deposit/week; early drop-off $25/wk, late pickup $35/wk. Also runs school-break camps.

camps.name: Snapology of Kennesaw STEM & Robotics Camps
camps.dates: Summer weeks (half and full day) plus school-break workshops

camps.name: Marietta Cobb Museum of Art Youth Art Camps
camps.price_note: Preschool and teen half-day camps $185 ($165 members). No before/after care.
camps.dates: 2027: Winter Feb 15–19, Spring Apr 5–9, Summer weeks June 14–July 23; 9am–3pm
camps.registration: Enrollment open now for 2027; closes the Wednesday before each session

camps.name: East Cobb Stables Summer Horse Camp
camps.price_note: Half day 8:30am–1pm; $100 deposit; 7–10 kids per week.
camps.registration: 2026: every week FULL as of May 7, 2026
